note: LMU replay websockets (:6398), Road Atlanta, 39 cars, captured live 2026-10-12 mid-replay. `ui` = two whole LiveStandings pushes (unused row fields dropped), `replaymetrics` = the camera-car push just before each (lapTimestamps cut to 3), `restFocus` = GET /rest/watch/focus at the time, `trackLengthM` = REST sessionInfo.lapDistance, `endEventTime` = sessionInfo. `track` = every other LiveStandings push over the 30 s for seven cars as [slotID, currentLapsCompleted, lapDist, position], stamped with the replay event time (replayStartET + currentReplayPos) of the latest replaymetrics push.
